subject: Operations
title: Process Types
description: A short lesson to help you apply Process Types.

hook.text: A bakery, a car factory, and an oil refinery all make products—but their processes couldn't be more different.

buildup.text: Process types range from project (unique, one-off) through jobbing, batch, mass production, to continuous flow.

discovery.text: Each type matches a volume-variety mix. High variety needs flexible processes; high volume needs efficient ones.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong process type is catastrophic—batch processes for mass-market products kill both cost and speed.

climax.text: The product-process matrix maps the ideal match: low volume with flexible processes, high volume with flow processes.

punchline.text: Match your process to your product. Mismatches are expensive.

quiz.question: What does the product-process matrix match?
